rows.name: Lido
farm_steps: Prepare a dedicated EOA wallet on Ethereum with enough native gas tokens and $500 in stablecoins. Cost: $510 total. Time: 10 minutes.
Liquid stake $500 worth of native assets through Lido to receive the protocol's liquid receipt token. Cost: Market price + $5 gas. Time: 5 minutes.
Bridge or deposit your receipt tokens into a supported L2 integration to double-dip on potential rewards. Cost: $15 in gas/bridging. Time: 10 minutes.
Hold the receipt token for at least 60 days to maximize your 'longevity' multiplier in the points system. Cost: Opportunity cost of capital. Time: 60 days.
Regularly check for governance votes on Snapshot.org or the protocol's own DAO portal and participate. Cost: Usually free (gasless). Time: 5 minutes per week.
Monitor the official Discord for 'Early Adopter' roles which often correlate with higher allocation tiers. Cost: Personal time. Time: 15 minutes total.
